name: infra
description: Operate the shared Infomaniak platform from any repository: diagnose a failure to the layer that owns it, take a change through PR, merge, apply and live proof, and work the database, cluster, Cloudflare edge, identity, object storage, network policy, tenants, and app deploys.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose, change, and verify the shared infrastructure platform.
interface.longDescription: Infra packages operational skills for the shared Infomaniak platform: a symptom router for when something breaks, a change-to-production loop that ends in live evidence rather than a green pipeline, a verification tier picker, a health sweep, and domain skills for PostgreSQL, the Kubernetes cluster, the Cloudflare edge, Zitadel identity, object storage, network policy, tenant lifecycle, and application deploys.
defaultPrompt: Something is broken — find out what.
Take this infrastructure change to production.
